description: 기본 예제: 주석 공격, 항상 참 우회, 정상 로그인 및 비번 오류
input:
6
REGISTER admin secret123 SUPERADMIN
REGISTER alice rabbit456 USER
ATTACK_LOGIN admin' -- wrongpassword
ATTACK_LOGIN ' OR '1'='1 hackerpass
ATTACK_LOGIN alice rabbit456
ATTACK_LOGIN alice wrongpass
expected_output:
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:admin:SUPERADMIN SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:admin:SUPERADMIN SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:alice:USER SECURE:SUCCESS:alice:USER
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL

description: 주석 공격 변형: '-- 및 ' -- 형태, 없는 유저 주석 공격, 정상 로그인
input:
9
REGISTER root toor SUPERADMIN
REGISTER manager pass123 MANAGER
REGISTER developer code456 DEV
ATTACK_LOGIN root'-- anypass
ATTACK_LOGIN manager' -- whatever
ATTACK_LOGIN developer'-- 9999
ATTACK_LOGIN unknown' -- fakepass
ATTACK_LOGIN root toor
ATTACK_LOGIN root wrongtoor
expected_output:
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:root:SUPERADMIN SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:manager:MANAGER SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:developer:DEV SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:root:SUPERADMIN SECURE:SUCCESS:root:SUPERADMIN
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL

description: 항상 참 우회 변형: 대소문자 혼합, 따옴표 유무, 첫 번째 등록 유저(guest) 탈취 검증
input:
7
REGISTER guest guestpass GUEST
REGISTER admin masterpass SUPERADMIN
ATTACK_LOGIN ' OR '1'='1 pw1
ATTACK_LOGIN ' or '1'='1 pw2
ATTACK_LOGIN ' OR 1=1 pw3
ATTACK_LOGIN 'or1=1 pw4
ATTACK_LOGIN admin masterpass
expected_output:
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:guest:GUEST SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:guest:GUEST SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:guest:GUEST SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:guest:GUEST SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:admin:SUPERADMIN SECURE:SUCCESS:admin:SUPERADMIN

description: 특수문자 비밀번호 정상 로그인, 대소문자 불일치, 미등록 유저 주석 실패
input:
8
REGISTER user1 P@ssw0rd!#% USER
REGISTER user2 Complex_Pass^77 USER
ATTACK_LOGIN user1 P@ssw0rd!#%
ATTACK_LOGIN user1 p@ssw0rd!#%
ATTACK_LOGIN user2 Complex_Pass^77
ATTACK_LOGIN user2 WrongPass
ATTACK_LOGIN not_exist secret
ATTACK_LOGIN not_exist' -- 123
expected_output:
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:user1:USER SECURE:SUCCESS:user1:USER
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:user2:USER SECURE:SUCCESS:user2:USER
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL

description: 유저 0명 빈 DB 공격 시 FAIL 방어 및 단일 유저 등록 후 동작 검증
input:
6
ATTACK_LOGIN ' OR '1'='1 bypass
ATTACK_LOGIN admin' -- pass
REGISTER solo solo_key ADMIN
ATTACK_LOGIN ' OR '1'='1 bypass

ATTACK_LOGIN solo solo_key
expected_output:
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:FAIL SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:solo:ADMIN SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:solo:ADMIN SECURE:FAIL
AUTH NAIVE:SUCCESS:solo:ADMIN SECURE:SUCCESS:solo:ADMIN
